messages:
Ava: heads-up — we have an after-hours demo sprint tomorrow 6pm PT. Need: registration page, Zoom setup (cloud recording + backup), and post-event edit + lead routing plan. 45m demo + 15m Q&A.
Sam: noted. I can own run-of-show and greenroom. who owns the reg page copy/CTAs?
Maya: I can draft reg copy. Thinking 2 CTAs: "Register" + "Get reminder & resources" (pre-check). Want to A/B subject lines for reminder emails.
Luis: Zoom ops — recommend: enable automatic cloud recording (host only), cloud recording to be saved to account + RTMP fallback to OBS -> S3 if cloud fails. Also enable waiting room, require authenticated users?
Ava: don't gate with auth — want max signups. But enable waiting room so we can vet panelists quickly. Luis, can you add RTMP fallback runbook?
Luis: yes. Quick runbook snippet:```bash
# RTMP fallback (OBS)
obs --startstream --rtmp-url rtmp://s3-fallback.example.com/live/KEY
# Lambda watches for missing cloud recording then copies RTMP to recordings-bucket
```
Sam: for recording ownership: post-event edit -> 48h first cut by Sam, then ops hands to Maya for highlight clipping. Ops (Luis) to upload raw and transcription to GDrive + S3.
Maya: highlight clips: 2x 60s social clips + 1x 5m teaser. I'll own messaging for nurture. Need speaker names + headshots by EOD today.
Ava: speakers: Priya, Chen, and Marco — I'll ping them. Also we need UTM params on all reg links and a hidden field for demo interest (routing key).
Maya: lead routing plan: if interest = "enterprise" -> Salesforce owner queue; if "pilot" or blank -> marketing nurture. ZapierBot: will route form -> HubSpot -> SFDC mapping.
ZapierBot: webhook created: https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/abc123/... (internal only). Mapping: email, name, utm_source, demo_interest, company, job_title.
Sam: run-of-show: 17:45 greenroom open, 18:00 start recording, 18:45 Q&A, 19:00 wrap + end recording. Luis: please ensure cloud recording auto-starts at 18:00 and retention set to 30 days.
Luis: will set recording retention and add postprocess lambda to generate VTT and speaker diarization tag. Also I'll add a health check that pings the RTMP endpoint 10 minutes before start.
Ava: CTA copy drafts: Option A: "Save my spot & get the demo replay"; Option B: "Register for live demo + materials". Maya will A/B.
Maya: I'll set reminder cadence: 48h before (email 1), 2h before (email 2), 10m before (SMS opt-in if provided). Also plan nurture: Day 1 replay + highlight clip, Day 3 deep-dive email with CTA to request pilot.
Sam: post-event owners: Sam = first cut edit, Luis = raw assets + transcripts upload, Maya = nurture + clips, Ava = speaker comms & replay approval.
Ava: final ask — everyone confirm owners and post any blockers by 4pm today. I'll loop in Priya/Chen/Marco after confirmations. :thumbsup:
Luis: confirmed. No blockers on infra.
Maya: confirmed. I'll upload CTA variants to reg page by 3pm.
Sam: confirmed. I'll share run-of-show doc and greenroom link in this thread before EOD.
Ava: perfect. thanks team!
